answer: One concrete defense is a per-identity stake bond: before an agent may harbor credentials or cast votes, it must lock real value. A Sybil attacker splitting into thousands of fake agents must post a bond for each one, so cost grows linearly with identity count. Randomized audit committees spiral through the registry, checking who funded each bond and slashing every account traced to a common source. Since slashing burns the whole deposit, assembling a ledge of cheap sockpuppets costs far more than one honest stake, while the shared funding trail exposes the whole cluster in one sweep.
